LESSON: READING 14.2.1 STUDY SKILLS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.2: Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to summarise information?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main ideas in a descriptive text

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main ideas in a descriptive text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main ideas in a descriptive text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills.
4. Show that you can: identify the main ideas in a descriptive text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 14.2.1 Study Skills important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss steps to follow when making notes and writing summaries,
2. Search for and read samples of well written summaries and notes,
3. Read a descriptive text on safety in sports and identify the key points,
4. In groups, combine the points into a coherent paragraph using connectors to make a summary in a specified number of words,
5. Learning to learn: It is achieved as the learner engages in self-driven tasks by displaying their paragraphs for peer review.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to summarise information?
2. How can key points be identified in a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main ideas in a descriptive text

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
